insight_text: Screen reader could not parse the CAPTCHA element and was completely blocked
Participant was confused by legal terminology in the terms and conditions section
Minor label inconsistency on confirm button
Submit button did not respond on the first click requiring multiple attempts
Error message after failed login attempt was unclear and unhelpful
Date picker component was difficult to navigate using keyboard
Help text was not visible without scrolling down significantly
Upload button label was ambiguous and participant chose the wrong action
Page took an extremely long time to load causing participant to abandon and restart
Instruction wording was complex and participant reread it several times
Confirmation message text was ambiguous and participant was unsure if submission succeeded
Progress indicator label used jargon that participant did not understand
